item.title: Camp helps kids with brain injuries, but federal research funding uncertain
item.description: A Pennsylvania camp aids children recovering from brain injuries, but the future of federal funding for such research is uncertain.

item.title: Spokane wildfire evacuees return to hazardous conditions
item.description: Most evacuees have returned to homes near burn zones in Spokane, despite lingering toxin concerns.

item.title: How the AIDS crisis gave rise to a billion-dollar market betting on death
item.description: Investors now buy life insurance policies upfront and receive the payout upon the policyholder's death.

item.title: Can Trump's economic pressure on Iran succeed where airstrikes and talks failed?
item.description: New U.S. sanctions may impact Iran after months of conflict and years of economic strain.
